delimit_type.description: The character set used to surround htp markup tags. Must be one of: HTML, CURLY, SQUARE.

imgxy.description: Whether to automatically add width and height attributes to IMG tags.

depend.description: Whether to check file dependencies (input/include changes) before processing.

condense.description: Whether to strip all linefeeds from the output HTML to reduce file size.

quiet.description: Whether to suppress informational messages and only show warnings/errors.

precious.description: Whether to retain incomplete output files if processing fails.

response_file.description: Path to a response file listing input/output pairs and sub-responses. Leave empty for direct input/output processing.
